# AI Training by Evan Weber | learncowork.net

> Live, practical AI training and workflow implementation for individuals and companies. Core platforms include ChatGPT Work, OpenAI Codex, Claude Cowork, Claude Code, Replit, ChatGPT apps and connectors, and related agentic AI workflows.

## What Evan Offers

### AI Training for Individuals and Teams

Live sessions use the buyer's actual work, tools, files, and goals. Training can focus on one platform or compare multiple platforms. Individuals and small teams can book a one-hour session for $300 or a four-hour workshop for $1,000.

Book: https://learncowork.net/#pricing

### ChatGPT Work Training

Training on ChatGPT Work for longer, multi-step work and finished deliverables. Topics may include setup, files, Projects, apps, company knowledge, the built-in browser, scheduled tasks, workflow design, permissions, and human review.

Details: https://learncowork.net/chatgpt-work-training

### OpenAI Codex Training

Training on the Codex app and agentic software development. Topics may include projects, threads, agents, worktrees, skills, automations, Git and GitHub workflows, testing, code review, repository instructions, and safe delegation.

Details: https://learncowork.net/codex-training

### Claude Cowork Training

Training on Claude Cowork for agentic desktop and business work. Topics may include setup, files, plugins, connectors, MCP, role-specific workflows, human approvals, and team playbooks.

Details: https://learncowork.net/claude-cowork-training

### AI Coding and Vibe Coding Training

Training for Claude Code, Replit, Codex, GitHub Copilot, GitHub workflows, prototyping, testing, review, deployment planning, and safer AI-assisted development.

Details: https://learncowork.net/ai-coding-training

### Replit Consulting and Training

Hands-on consulting and advanced training for Replit Agent and AI-assisted product development. Evan helps individuals, founders, and companies plan, build, fix, test, and publish websites, landing pages, SaaS products, internal tools, business software, APIs, prototypes, and mobile apps. Team training covers specifications, Agent workflows, checkpoints, GitHub, testing, review, permissions, publishing, and responsible human oversight.

Details: https://learncowork.net/replit-consulting

### AI Workflow Consulting and Implementation

Done-with-you support for workflow audits, use-case prioritization, tool selection, pilot builds, apps and connectors, guardrails, documentation, role-based training, adoption, and measurement.

Details: https://learncowork.net/ai-workflow-consulting

### SEO, AEO, and GEO Training

Training on search visibility and LLM citation readiness, including crawlability, content architecture, entities, structured data, direct-answer content, evidence, authority, internal linking, and measurement.

Details: https://learncowork.net/aeo-geo-training

## Who the Training Is For

- Individuals, founders, consultants, and solo professionals
- Business teams in marketing, sales, operations, support, finance, HR, legal, leadership, and project management
- Developers, product managers, agencies, and technical teams
- Companies choosing between ChatGPT Work, Codex, Claude Cowork, Claude Code, Replit, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, Perplexity, or a mixed AI stack
- Organizations that need both training and workflow implementation
